business_summary: HS Hwasung Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of construction services in the areas of public works, architecture, housing, environmental engineering, plants, and engineering consultation in South Korea. The company offers civil engineering services for roads, ports and rivers, and subway and other projects; architecture services for offices and industrial facilities, public and spectator facilities, education/research and medical facilities, and distribution and leisure facilities; and housing services, such as apartment housing, officetel, renovations and redevelopment, and urban regeneration. It also provides landscaping services; environmental services in the areas of waterworks and water treatment facilities, waste treatment facilities, livestock wastewater and excreta treatment facilities, water recycling facilities, air quality and waste, and noise/vibration; and recycling and renewable energy services, as well as fabricates and supplies steel structures, including steel frames and bridges for various buildings and facilities. In addition, the company offers PC construction services, such as long-span structures, and PC complex and sports stadium facilities; and engineering services in the areas of roads and structures, water resources, waterworks, city planning and landscaping, safety diagnosis, water quality management and waste treatment, machinery, electricity, information telecommunications, environment, disaster prevention, and traffic. The company was formerly known as Hwasung Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to HS Hwasung Co., Ltd. in July 2024. HS Hwasung Co., Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Daegu, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: HS화성주식회사는 한국에서 토목공사, 건축, 주택, 환경공학, 플랜트, 엔지니어링 컨설팅 분야의 건설 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 도로, 항만, 하천, 지하철 및 기타 프로젝트에 대한 토목 엔지니어링 서비스를 제공합니다. 사무실 및 산업 시설, 공공 및 관람 시설, 교육/연구 및 의료 시설, 유통 및 레저 시설에 대한 건축 서비스; 아파트, 오피스텔, 재건축, 재개발, 도시재생 등 주거서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 조경 서비스도 제공합니다. 수도 및 수처리 시설, 폐기물 처리 시설, 축산 폐수 및 분뇨 처리 시설, 물 재활용 시설, 대기 질 및 폐기물, 소음/진동 분야의 환경 서비스; 재활용 및 재생에너지 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 각종 건물 및 시설물에 사용되는 철골, 교량 등 철구조물을 제작, 공급하고 있습니다. 또한 장스팬 구조물, PC 복합단지, 스포츠 경기장 시설 등 PC 시공 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 엔지니어링
